items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: There was Clarence, Ernie and Vic. ... He was a terrific scatter. He reminded me of Leo Watson.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember them. There was a good one, too, who... Clarence was a good singer.
There was Clarence, Ernie and Vic.
Clarence could have made it as a solo. He was excellent.
